project.project_description: Purchase of six bid-item types of three-phase pad-mounted distribution transformers to replenish municipal utility inventory.

package_subscope: Six three-phase pad-mounted transformer bid items ranging from 300 kVA to 1500 kVA, with specified secondary voltages.
